items.source: Default constructor that uses StandardWebSocketUpgradeStrategy.
items.translation: 使用StandardWebSocketUpgradeStrategy的默认构造函数。

items.source: Determine the sub-protocols supported by the given WebSocketHandler by checking whether it is an instance of SubProtocolCapable.
items.translation: 通过检查它是否是SubProtocolCapable的实例，来确定给定的 WebSocketHandler 支持的子协议。

items.source: If the negotiation succeeds, the actual upgrade is delegated to a server-specific RequestUpgradeStrategy, which will update the response as necessary and initialize the WebSocket. As of 7.0, this class uses StandardWebSocketUpgradeStrategy unless explicitly configured.
items.translation: 如果协商成功，实际的升级将委托给特定于服务器的 RequestUpgradeStrategy，该策略将根据需要更新响应并初始化 WebSocket。从 7.0 版本开始，除非显式配置，否则该类使用 StandardWebSocketUpgradeStrategy。

items.source: Note that if the WebSocketHandler passed in at runtime is an instance of SubProtocolCapable then there is no need to explicitly configure this property. That is certainly the case with the built-in STOMP over WebSocket support. Therefore, this property should be configured explicitly only if the WebSocketHandler does not implement SubProtocolCapable.
items.translation: 请注意，如果在运行时传入的 `WebSocketHandler` 是 `SubProtocolCapable` 接口的实例，则无需显式配置此属性。内置的基于 WebSocket 的 STOMP 支持确实属于这种情况。因此，仅当 `WebSocketHandler` 未实现 `SubProtocolCapable` 时，才应显式配置此属性。

items.source:
Performs initial validation of the WebSocket handshake request - possibly rejecting it
through the appropriate HTTP status code - while also allowing its subclasses to override
various parts of the negotiation process: for example, origin validation, sub-protocol
negotiation, extensions negotiation, etc.
items.translation: 执行 WebSocket 握手请求的初始验证——可能通过适当的 HTTP 状态码拒绝该请求——同时允许其子类重写协商过程的各个部分：例如，源验证、子协议协商、扩展协商等。

items.source:
As of 4.1, the default implementation of this method filters the list to
leave only extensions that are both requested and supported.
items.translation: 自 4.1 版本起，此方法的默认实现会过滤列表，仅保留既被请求又被支持的扩展。

items.source:
Subclasses can provide custom logic for associating a user with a session,
for example for assigning a name to anonymous users (i.e. not fully authenticated).
items.translation: 子类可以为将用户与会话关联提供自定义逻辑，例如为匿名用户（即未完全认证的用户）分配名称。

items.source: Perform the sub-protocol negotiation based on requested and supported sub-protocols. For the list of supported sub-protocols, this method first checks if the target WebSocketHandler is a SubProtocolCapable and then also checks if any sub-protocols have been explicitly configured with setSupportedProtocols(String...).
items.translation: 根据请求和支持的子协议执行子协议协商。对于支持子协议的列表，此方法首先检查目标 WebSocketHandler 是否为 SubProtocolCapable，然后还检查是否已通过setSupportedProtocols(String...)显式配置了任何子协议。

items.source: Return whether the request Origin header value is valid or not. By default, all origins as considered as valid. Consider using an OriginHandshakeInterceptor for filtering origins if needed.
items.translation: 返回请求 `Origin` 头值是否有效。默认情况下，所有源均被视为有效。如需过滤源，请考虑使用 OriginHandshakeInterceptor。

items.source: HandshakeFailureException - thrown when handshake processing failed to complete due to an internal, unrecoverable error, i.e. a server error as opposed to a failure to successfully negotiate the handshake.
items.translation: HandshakeFailureException - 当握手处理因内部不可恢复的错误而未能完成时抛出，即服务器错误，而非握手协商失败。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。
